CustomField.label: Risk Last Alerted Date
CustomField.description: Date the advisor was last alerted and the student last got a check-in for a risk-score crossing. Used to stop repeat alerts within the cooldown (7 days). Set by RT – Contact – Risk Crossing. Origin: SCA-4 / SCA-13.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the advisor was last alerted about this student.
